meta.disclaimer: Dated, testable predictions and how they turned out. Hit rate is correct/(correct+wrong); open and unfalsifiable are excluded from that denominator and the unfalsifiable share is reported alongside, so a source cannot score well by saying nothing testable. Research support, not investment advice.
